subject: Arbor Data onboarding roadmap and milestone owners
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@arbordata.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@arbordata.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 03 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP and target go-live (ask: confirm owners + dates)

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Arbor_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) and an integration checklist (arbor-integration-checklist.pdf). The goal here is to lock down milestone owners and a target go-live so your internal teams (engineering, security, procurement) can align.

Key asks from our side:
- Can you confirm a target go-live window of 2029-08-12 to 2029-08-16 (preferred 2029-08-15)?
- Will Arbor own the SAML configuration and test users, or should Redwood provide a turnkey dev tenant?
- Procurement: is PO + signed SOW the gating item, or do you require SOC2 evidence first?

High level milestones in the sheet: kickoff (week of 6/10), security review, integration sprint, UAT, go/no-go, and production cutover. I’ve put tentative owners in column D but want your confirmation.

Proposed next steps:
1) Review attachments and comment in the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdExAMPLE)
2) Confirm owners and any missing tasks by EOD 2029-06-05
3) Sign the SOW (DocuSign link to follow) if the timeline looks good — target SOW sign-off by 2029-06-12 so we can start dev work 6/17.

Attachments: Arbor_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (MAP), arbor-integration-checklist.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you prefer to walk the sheet together.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0189

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@arbordata.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@arbordata.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 04 Jun 2029 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and target go-live (ask: confirm owners + dates)

Naomi —

Thanks for the clear plan and the docs. A few quick clarifications from our side before we lock owners:
- Procurement will need SOC 2 Type II report and a short data-retention summary before we can issue a PO. Can you drop the SOC2 link or artifact in the Drive?
- Security: we plan to handle SAML setup internally but will need a Redwood test tenant for end-to-end verification. Can you provision one by 6/14?
- Integrations: our ETL team prefers a 2-week integration window followed by 1 week of joint UAT. If you’re proposing dev work to start 6/17, that aligns but we’ll need confirmed daily standups for the integration sprint.

Proposed internal owners (quick sketch):
- SAML / Auth: Tom Li
- Data ingestion / ETL: Chris Manning (consulting lead)
- Procurement / Legal: me (Aisha Khan)

We’ll review the sheet and aim to provide comments in the Drive by EOD 6/05. Procurement will try to get the SOC2 ask handled quickly — can Redwood share the evidence link today?

Thanks,
Aisha
Head of Operations
Arbor Data Systems
aisha.khan@arbordata.com
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@arbordata.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@arbordata.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 04 Jun 2029 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and target go-live (ask: confirm owners + dates)

Hi all —

Thanks Aisha. Quick responses inline and a suggested milestone slate below (we’ll update the sheet after you confirm):

SOC2 artifacts: Naomi, can you upload the SOC2 link to the Drive today — we’ll include it under "Compliance" in the MAP.
Test tenant: Naomi can provision a dev tenant by 6/14 — we’ll include a credentials handoff task.
Daily standups: agreed for the 2-week integration sprint (6/24 — 7/05).

Proposed milestone schedule (owners & dates):
- Kickoff & executive alignment: 2029-06-10 — Owner: Naomi Feldman (Redwood) / Aisha Khan (Arbor)
- Security evidence & procurement checklist complete: 2029-06-12 — Owner: Naomi (upload) / Aisha (review)
- SOW signed (DocuSign): 2029-06-12 — Owner: Naomi / Legal teams
- Dev tenant provisioned & credentials: 2029-06-14 — Owner: Redwood Infra (Naomi coord.)
- Integration window (ETL, APIs): 2029-06-17 to 2029-06-28 — Owner: Chris Manning (Arbor) / Jonas Weber (Redwood eng lead)
- Joint UAT: 2029-07-01 to 2029-07-05 — Owner: Arbor QA / Redwood QA
- Performance tuning & SLA validation: 2029-07-08 to 2029-07-19 — Owner: Redwood SRE (Jonas)
- Cutover rehearsal (dry run): 2029-07-29 — Owner: Arbor ops + Redwood ops
- Go/no-go decision: 2029-08-01 — Owner: Executive sponsors
- Production cutover: 2029-08-15 (target) — Owner: Arbor ops / Redwood ops

A few implementation notes:
- If Arbor prefers Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput we should finalize that no later than 6/12 (affects procurement sizing).
- We’ll keep a short risk register in the sheet; Naomi will add initial risks.

I’ll update the MAP with these milestones and ping the Drive link. Naomi — if you can attach the DocuSign SOW link after you generate the envelope, we’ll push for signatures by 6/12.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions Engineering
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@arbordata.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@arbordata.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 06 Jun 2029 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated MAP v0.3 (Drive + DocuSign) — request: sign-off by 6/12

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I uploaded the SOC2 evidence and the updated MAP (Arbor_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) to the Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdExAMPLE. I also created the DocuSign envelope for the SOW; link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/example.

What I updated:
- Milestones per Karthik’s slate (integration window + UAT)
- Added risk register (3 initial risks) and mitigation owners
- Added a short procurement checklist (SOC2, PO, billing contact)

Ask: please review and provide sign-off (or redlines) by EOD 2029-06-12. If we get signatures by then we can start the integration sprint on 2029-06-17 as planned. I’ll schedule a recurring 30m integration standup starting 2029-06-24 (Mon-Fri, 9:30am PT) and send invites once you confirm.

Attachments: Arbor_MAP_v0.3.xlsx, arbor-integration-checklist.pdf

Best,
Naomi
From: Tom Li <tom.li@arbordata.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@arbordata.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 06 Jun 2029 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Updated MAP v0.3 (Drive + DocuSign) — request: sign-off by 6/12

Naomi / team —

I reviewed the updated MAP and the SOC2 doc you uploaded — thanks. We’re aligned on the timeline and I’ll coordinate with Chris to start the ETL work on 6/17. We’ll aim to complete internal SAML config by 6/14 and join the daily standups during the integration window.

I’ll review the SOW and sign via DocuSign today. Expect a PO to follow once legal confirms billing terms.

Tom
Senior Platform Engineer
Arbor Data Systems
